title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Joshua 18: the survey of the land at Shiloh and the lot and borders of Benjamin.

questions.text: Where did the whole congregation of Israel assemble and set up the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 says the congregation assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there.

questions.text: How many tribes had not yet divided their inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:2 says seven tribes remained which had not yet divided their inheritance.

questions.text: How many men did Joshua tell the Israelites to appoint from each tribe to walk through the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua told them to appoint three men from each tribe to walk through the land and describe it.

questions.text: Why did the Levites have no portion of the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 says the Levites had no portion because the priesthood of Yahweh was their inheritance.

answers.text: They had already received land east of the Jordan
They had refused to cross the Jordan
Their lot had not yet come out
The priesthood of Yahweh was their inheritance

questions.text: In what did the men write down their survey of the land, by cities in seven portions?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:9 says they surveyed the land by cities into seven portions in a book.

answers.text: On a map in the sand

questions.text: Between which two peoples did the border of Benjamin's lot go out?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:11 says Benjamin's border went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

questions.text: By what other name was Luz also called?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:13 speaks of Luz, also called Bethel.

questions.text: Kiriath Baal, where Benjamin's west border ended, was also called what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:14 says the border ended at Kiriath Baal, also called Kiriath Jearim, a city of the children of Judah.

questions.text: Benjamin's south border went down to the stone of which person?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:17 says the border went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

questions.text: Which city in Benjamin's list is called "the Jebusite"?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:28 lists "the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem)" among the cities of Benjamin.
